# `adi-mcp` — types

> MCP (Model Context Protocol) server definitions an ADI agent may be given: global or filed under a project, one TOML manifest per server under ~/.adi/mono/mcp. Pure library — no transport is spoken here, only the definitions and secret-reference resolution an agent's launch reads.

## `src/transport.rs`

### enum `Value`

One header or environment value: either written out in full, or a secret's name to resolve at launch time. `#[serde(untagged)]` tells the two apart by shape alone — a bare TOML/JSON string is `Value::Literal`, a one-field table naming `secret` is `Value::Secret` — so a definition reads exactly as a publisher would write it by hand, no tag to remember.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(untagged)]
pub enum Value {
    Literal(String),
    Secret {
        secret: String,
    },
}
```

### enum `Transport`

How an MCP server is reached. Stored internally tagged (`kind = "http" | "stdio"`) so a manifest reads as one table rather than a choice buried in a nested one.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum Transport {
    Http {
        url: String,
        #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "BTreeMap::is_empty")]
        headers: BTreeMap<String, Value>,
    },
    Stdio {
        command: String,
        #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
        args: Vec<String>,
        #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "BTreeMap::is_empty")]
        env: BTreeMap<String, Value>,
    },
}
```
